source.label: Bethesda's Fallout 76 Community Calendars for Seasons 23 to 26 (December 2025 to December 2026)
source.note: Season 26 transcribed 2026-09-28 and Seasons 23 to 25 on 2026-10-12 from the official calendar images (nukaknights.com/roadmaps.html mirrors them). Where two calendars cover the same month the later one wins and its extra entries are kept. Event days run from daily reset to daily reset, noon Eastern. Mechanics notes follow Bethesda's published event descriptions.

entries.name: Holiday Scorched
entries.note: Festive Scorched spawn at set locations and drop Holiday Gifts with decoration and apparel plans.

entries.name: Mutated Public Events
entries.note: Hourly public events run with Daily Ops mutations; completion grants a Mutated Package (Mutated Party Pack for groups with three or more Fallout 1st members).

entries.name: Double Mutations
entries.note: Daily Ops enemies carry two mutations; runs pay double XP, currency and Legendary Cores at Elder tier.

entries.name: Gold Rush
entries.note: Daily gold bullion from Treasury Notes doubles from 400 to 800 per character.

entries.name: Treasure Hunter
entries.note: Legendary Treasure Hunter mole miners drop Mole Miner Pails (dusty, regular, ornate).

entries.name: Caps-a-Plenty
entries.note: NPC vendors' daily caps pool doubles from 1,400 to 2,800.

entries.name: Mothman Equinox
entries.note: Hourly cultist ritual at Point Pleasant: protect the bonfire, defeat the Cultist High Priests and commune with the Wise Mothman.
